title: Paramount+ Deal: How to Save Up to 93% Off A Streaming Subscription
summary: Ahead of Prime Day, you can sign up for Paramount+ for just $0.99 per month for a limited time.
contentText:

After the 30-day free trial is over, Prime Video (as a standalone service) starts at $8.99 per month with an ad-supported plan, while Amazon Prime starts at $14.99 per month, or $139 per year. Learn more about Amazon Prime and its benefits here .

What’s Streaming on Paramount+?

Paramount+ has a wide selection of original movies and TV shows (Showtime Originals for Paramount+ Premium ), such as Dutton Ranch , Star Trek: Strange New Worlds , Tulsa King , Seal Team , Mayor of Kingstown , Frasier (2023), The Chi , Billions , The Affair , Yellowjackets , The Circus and many others.

Meanwhile, it has a number of music programming to watch too, including Behind the Music , Willie Nelson & Family , The Carters: Hurts to Love You , How Music Got Free , Family Legacy , Lolla: The Story of Lollapalooza and others.

The streamer has live sports too, with access to games, matches and events from NFL, UEFA, PGA, WNBA, EFL, NWSL and other leagues, as well as all UFC broadcasts.

For Prime Day, you can get Paramount+ as an add-on channel for Prime Video on sale for $0.99 per month (regularly $8.99 per month for the Essential plan, or $13.99 per month for the Premium plan) for two months — a savings of up to 93% subscription prices.
